requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen.
Be 17 to 25 years old.
Provide a guardian certificate for a guardian who has Nanjing residency.
Be a senior-high graduate or hold a higher qualification.
Create an account in the NUAA admission system, upload every required document, pay the application fee and monitor the portal for status changes.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee.

references.locator: How to Apply: Upload documents and pay the application fee

requirements.ruleText: Submit the passport information page and the current Chinese visa if already in China.
Submit the senior-high diploma or a notarized copy; a 2026 graduate may submit a pre-graduation letter but must present the original diploma at registration.
Submit original or notarized transcripts for all senior-high courses.
Submit two signed recommendation letters from high-school teachers, including their contact details.
Submit a personal statement of no more than 800 words covering personal introduction, reasons for applying and individual strengths.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Submit a financial-guarantee letter or bank statement.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide a notarized Chinese or English translation.
Upload clear scans for review and bring every original for on-campus verification; enrollment is refused when originals are not provided.
Apply from November 15, 2025 through May 30, 2026; May 30 is the final application deadline.
Budget the published CNY 400 residence-permit charge; the guide says the amount is an average and subject to change.

Budget CNY 8,000 per year for a small single room, CNY 14,000 for a large single room, CNY 4,000 for a small double-room place, or CNY 7,000 for a large double-room place; published figures are averages and may change.
Take the CSCA Mathematics paper in English and submit the official result by May 30, 2026.

references.locator: How to Apply and Application Documents

requirements.ruleText: Submit HSK Level 4 or above.
Pay tuition of CNY 22,900 per academic year.

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health and have no criminal record.
Be younger than 35 years old.
Hold a bachelor's degree.
Demonstrate a strong academic background and research and innovation ability.
Submit IELTS 6.0 or above, TOEFL 70 or above, or an equivalent English-proficiency letter.
Complete the NUAA online application using accurate identity and contact details, pay the application fee and submit the application.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee.
Submit a scanned copy of the passport information page.
Submit the notarized bachelor's degree certificate in Chinese or English.
Submit a notarized copy of the highest academic transcript.
Submit an NUAA Supervisor Acceptance Letter.
Submit a study plan signed by an NUAA supervisor or professor.
Submit a recommendation letter from a professor or associate professor.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Record with blood-test report, issued within the preceding six months.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate issued within the preceding six months.
Submit a financial-guarantee letter or bank statement.
Submit the CSC application form.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Provide a notarized Chinese or English translation.
Upload clear scans for review and bring every original for on-campus verification; enrollment is refused when originals are not provided.
Applications opened November 15, 2025; May 30, 2026 was the recommended period end and June 15, 2026 was the published final deadline.
Budget the published CNY 400 annual residence-permit charge; the guide says the amount is an average and subject to change.

Budget CNY 8,000 per year for a small single room, CNY 14,000 for a large single room, CNY 4,000 for a small double-room place, or CNY 7,000 for a large double-room place; published figures are averages and may change.
Pay tuition of CNY 30,000 per academic year.
